video_title: How To Make Soft Layered Roti - Paratha

scene_context.setting: Indoor kitchen with white painted table, natural lighting, flour on surface.
people: Person wearing striped shirt and black apron, hands visible., Mixing dough, rolling flatbreads, placing oil on shaped buns.

cues.en: In a home kitchen, the cook mixes flour and water into a shaggy dough, then kneads it into a smooth ball.
They lift the dough ball onto a plate and pour oil over it.
The cook kneads oil into the dough inside the wooden bowl.
They roll each cut piece between their palms into round balls.
The cook flattens a dough ball and rolls it into an oval.
They fold the sheet into a tight cylinder.
The cook coils dough ball into bun.
They roll the floured ball into a thin round flatbread, then flip it over.
The cook rolls the flipped flatbread thinner until it is a thin, even round roti.
